releaseNotes: V1003 adds direct primitive background and border color selection to the Device Scene Inspector without changing the schema-v5 color contract.
Rectangle, Rounded Rectangle, Ellipse, Line and Text continue to use the existing FillHex and StrokeHex properties; V1003 only adds compact preset swatches beside the existing HEX/token editors.
AUTO_SURFACE, AUTO_ACCENT, transparent and common engineering palette colors are available, while arbitrary #RRGGBB/#AARRGGBB values remain supported through the existing text fields.
Save Properties remains the only commit boundary, so palette clicks never bypass the existing draft/SSOT persistence contract.

The V1002 full-canvas resize interaction overlay is unchanged and remains the resize baseline. No HMI write authority, schema, communication, runtime, polling, AI grounding, Home layout, or protected control behavior is changed.

en: Primitive background and border colors can now be selected directly from compact Inspector palettes or entered as HEX values.
The existing schema-v5 FillHex/StrokeHex fields and Save Properties commit boundary are reused unchanged.
The V1002 resize interaction overlay remains unchanged.
ko: Primitive 객체의 배경 색상과 테두리 색상을 Inspector의 컴팩트 팔레트에서 직접 선택하거나 HEX 값으로 입력할 수 있습니다.
기존 Schema v5의 FillHex/StrokeHex 필드와 속성 저장 커밋 경계를 그대로 재사용합니다.
V1002 Resize Interaction Overlay는 변경하지 않았습니다.
ja: Primitive オブジェクトの背景色と枠線色を Inspector のコンパクトパレットから直接選択するか、HEX 値で入力できるようになりました。
既存の Schema v5 FillHex/StrokeHex とプロパティ保存のコミット境界をそのまま再利用します。
V1002 Resize Interaction Overlay は変更していません。
zh-CN: 现在可在 Inspector 紧凑调色板中直接选择 Primitive 对象的背景颜色和边框颜色，也可继续输入 HEX 值。
继续复用现有 Schema v5 的 FillHex/StrokeHex 字段和保存属性提交边界。
V1002 Resize Interaction Overlay 保持不变。
de: Hintergrund- und Rahmenfarben von Primitive-Objekten können jetzt direkt über kompakte Inspector-Farbpaletten gewählt oder weiterhin als HEX-Wert eingegeben werden.
Die vorhandenen Schema-v5-Felder FillHex/StrokeHex und die Commit-Grenze Eigenschaften speichern werden unverändert weiterverwendet.
Das V1002 Resize Interaction Overlay bleibt unverändert.
es: Los colores de fondo y borde de los objetos Primitive ahora pueden seleccionarse directamente desde paletas compactas del Inspector o introducirse como valores HEX.
Se reutilizan sin cambios los campos FillHex/StrokeHex del Schema v5 y el límite de confirmación Guardar propiedades.
El Resize Interaction Overlay de V1002 permanece sin cambios.
